name: fuel-tanker
title: Fuel tanker ship (mission 5 naval targets)
usage: Mission 5: two tankers at sea (one near the start route, one near the rig complex); naval targets. Pending independent safety review; not uploaded; not referenced from src/.

noText.note: No letters, numbers or symbols anywhere: no hull number, name, port of registry, draught marks, funnel mark or company colours. Paint is plain charcoal topsides, a black boot-top, red antifouling, a green-grey deck and an off-white deckhouse with rows of plain windows.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No company, product or brand marks; the funnel is plain off-white with a soot-dark top.

noRealMilitaryInsignia.note: No flags, ensigns or markings; an original tanker layout (deckhouse aft, raised forecastle, three cargo lines, a two-pipe manifold, catwalk to starboard of the pipes), not a copy of any real or game ship.

noFaces.note: No faces, figures or crew. Head-on the bow is a plain raked stem with no hawse pipes, anchors or dark openings; the deckhouse front has rows of many small windows and a wide bridge band, which reads as a building. Checked in preview-front, preview-closeup-bow and preview-closeup-deckhouse.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary hard-surface or natural forms reviewed in all four previews.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: A civilian-type cargo ship: no guns, launchers or weapons; nothing damaged or burning.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

previewNotes.preview-top-orientation.png: Review aid only (not in the FBX): orthographic from above, same framing as preview-top.png, with a plain orange arrow from stern to bow on the centre line. The hose crane and rescue boat are on the image's right, the starboard side.

orientation: Bow at Roblox -Z; starboard = Roblox +X (right when facing the bow), which carries the hose crane at the manifold, the raised catwalk (just starboard of the pipes) and the rescue boat on the deckhouse. Authored front -Y, Z up, so starboard is Blender -X; the plan is mirrored to put those features there. The FBX export and the Roblox import only rotate (Blender (x, y, z) -> Roblox (-x, z, y)), so no import mirrors a side. preview-top-orientation.png shows a review-only arrow from stern to bow.
waterline: groundOffsetStuds = 16: the waterline is 16 studs above the keel (the model's lowest point). Place the pivot (bottom centre) 16 studs below the sea surface.
design: Original medium tanker: raked stem with a bulbous bow, parallel midbody, transom stern, raised forecastle with a breakwater, deckhouse of three tiers plus bridge aft with bridge wings, a raked funnel, three longitudinal cargo pipes, a two-pipe manifold midships, a raised catwalk, tank hatches, a starboard hose crane, a free-fall lifeboat on a stern ramp, a rescue boat on a starboard davit, a foremast and mooring winches. No hull number or name.
sizeRationale: 266.7 studs overall (260 at the waterline plus the raked stem and bulb) x 46 beam. At the fighters' ~1.44 studs per metre this is a ~185 m medium tanker (32 m beam): 10 Vanta lengths, about half the 560-stud carrier. The legacy frigate (430 studs) is authored at 0.28 m per stud and is oversized next to this ship; keep them apart or scale the frigate down.
reviewStatus: pending independent safety review (AGENTS.md); not uploaded; not referenced from src/

scaleReference.note: Review aid only: an approved, already uploaded asset placed at in-game size for scale. Not part of this asset or its FBX.
